name: Shadow's Embrace
body:
Shadow's Embrace (Su) [Star Tower]
Source Mythic Realms pg. 15
As an immediate action, you can expend one use of mythic power to become both corporeal and incorporeal for 1 round. During that round, you can instantly shift between corporeal and incorporeal as an immediate action. If you become corporeal while inside a solid object, you are expelled and take 5d6 points of damage. You can expend one additional use of mythic power each round as a free action to extend the effects of shadow's embrace by 1 round.
